text:
Alex M: Quick check — we need to lock the finalization / handoff timeslot for the 3.2 cut. Two options: Tue 3/30 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 3/31 15:00-16:00 PT. Please RSVP and confirm smoke/canary owners. Draft agenda below.

Maya R: Tue 10am PT works for me. Is that 1pm ET?

Alex M: Yep — Tue 10:00 PT = 13:00 ET. Thanks @Maya R :thumbsup:

Sanjay P: I can own canary validation on Tue. Will need a heads-up 30m before cut to warm caches.

Linda C: Add security sign-off to the agenda please — quick token rotation check and SSO smoke. I might be tied up Wed afternoon.

Ryan J: I'm good for Tue as well. Can someone drop the preflight checklist link? I want to run the infra smoke locally beforehand.

Alex M: Preflight checklist: https://internal.redwood/3.2/preflight-checklist (short version below). We'll call out owners.

Alex M: ```Agenda (30-45m)
- Roll call & stakeholder confirmation (5m)
- Readiness summary: tests, perf, infra (10m)
- Canary plan & owner handoff (10m)
- Security & compliance sign-off (5m)
- Cut timeline & rollback criteria (5m)
- Action items + post-cut monitoring owner (5m)```

OpsBot: Deploy calendar updated: 2026-03-30T17:00Z reserved for release 3.2 (canary window + 30m warm). Assigned channel: #deploy-ops.

Maya R: One ask — can we move the meeting to 09:30 PT for a 30m buffer? I have a customer sync at 10:30.

Alex M: We can do 09:30-10:15 PT if that helps. Does that break anyone?

Sanjay P: 09:30 still fine for me. I can shift warm-up earlier.

Linda C: 09:30 would be better — helps avoid my Wed conflict. :+1:

Ryan J: 09:30 works. +1 to concise agenda.

Alex M: OK locking 2026-03-30 09:30-10:15 PT. I'll update calendar invite and the release doc. Final attendee ask: please add your name and primary backup in the doc here: https://internal.redwood/3.2/release-owners.

Maya R: Added myself and @Sanjay P as backup for canary validation.

Sanjay P: Added: I put @Ryan J as infra backup.

Linda C: Security sign-off owner: Linda C, backup: @Alex M. Added to doc.

Alex M: Thanks — last call: any blockers that should prevent cut? Reply here if yes, otherwise consider this the RSVP thread.

Ryan J: No blockers from infra. I'll run the local smoke tonight and post results in the doc.

Maya R: No blockers from product side.

Sanjay P: No blockers. Will confirm canary scripts by EOD.

Linda C: No blockers, but request a 10-minute security review slot in the meeting (I'll keep it tight).

Alex M: Noted. Agenda updated. Calendar invite sent to listed attendees. Thanks all — see you Tue 09:30 PT. :rocket:
